entities.name: Göran von Otter
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Baron Göran Fredrik von Otter was a Swedish diplomat and friherre, best known for his service in Berlin during World War II. Birgitta and Anne Sofie von Otter are von Otter's daughters; former Swedish Prime Minister Fredrik von Otter was his grandfather.
